# Layer 32 of ROCK.goo, as the runs its chunk stream encodes.
#
# ROCK.goo is a sample file distributed by Elegoo with the Mars 5
# printer, sliced by Voxeldance Tango 4.0.17.10 at 4098x2560 into
# 1000 layers. This is 1 of those 1000, decoded from the vendor's
# chunks back into the runs they carry.
#
# It is here so the chunk encoder can be measured against output a
# real producer wrote, rather than only against this project's own
# idea of the format. The vendor packs these runs into 8127 bytes,
# magic byte and checksum included.
#
# One run per line, "<value> <length>", in stream order. Values are
# 8-bit grayscale, lengths are pixel counts. Lines opening with '#'
# are comments.
